goal: Integrate and verify: Offline multi-role lifecycle capstone

allowed_scope.extent: Denied-network complete lifecycle with fresh verifier and actual local Git publication/retrieval, rejection/rework, wrong-candidate refusal, missing/miscorrelated durable role outcome, duplicate/restart and judgment hold. Exactly one authorized effect and actual closure receipts. Custody/verifier/binding/correlation mutations must fail. Label every external substitution and make no live proof claim.
allowed_scope.boundary: Only this node extent. Requirement/design references constrain execution and do not absorb sibling scopes.
non_goals: Replanning the DAG or implementing another node; changing requirements, closing authority gaps or selecting withdrawn architecture policy.
Automatic release, live operation or retirement from a candidate or local proof result.
Inventing or repairing upstream capabilities inside this capstone; return defects to their named provider.
architecture_constraints: Apply the pinned shared contracts and linked contract sections within this node extent. No service or context boundary beyond the pinned design, RAI wiring or adopted withdrawn edge table.
Preserve compatible interfaces, persisted resource identities, one-writer ownership and existing approved architecture checks.
Use canonical WorkerProvider and durable invocation/effect/execution evidence. Missing/miscorrelated outcome holds; no RoleOutcomeRecord sidecar or scenario-written lifecycle state.

dependencies.completion_predicate: With K1/K2 predecessor proof, actual sandbox_run_profile and github_profile constructors using local transports refuse missing/miscorrelated role authority, candidate custody or durable outcome binding before worker launch. A correctly bound real adapter reaches correlated success/rejection/restart readback through existing WorkerProvider/evidence ownership. Disconnect correlation or bypass the binding guard and the proof must fail. No live/shared-profile activation is claimed.

Real temporary SQLite; disposable local bare Git remote, publication/fetch into a fresh verifier worktree, local work-management and provider transport, injected clock/IDs, durable scripted worker journal, credentials absent and enforced denied outbound network with attempted-network refusal. Count zero provider calls. Run existing kernel unchanged and report success-collapse limitation; no scripted lifecycle transitions.

DONE/judgment events dedupe across restart; notification failure preserves pending. SEEN is not RESOLVED; wrong actor/revision/lane cannot resolve. DecisionInbox remains distinct. Unbound activation causes zero model launches. Preserve origin IDs, history and handler attribution.

required_evidence: Retain exact fixture/source/profile/candidate revisions, invocation and command, expected/observed result, exit status, immutable observation refs, independent verdict where required; never infer operational success from a local result.

Retain predecessor candidate identities, proof fixture revision, full command/exit status, raw observations, negative-control application counts and independent verdicts separately. Preserve prior proof on repair; supersession needs explicit authority.
Retain all authority dispositions and migration/rollback/readback receipts applicable to this node. Missing or unavailable measurements are explicit holds, never zero or PASS.

criteria: Denied-network complete lifecycle with fresh verifier and actual local Git publication/retrieval, rejection/rework, wrong-candidate refusal, missing/miscorrelated durable role outcome, duplicate/restart and judgment hold. Exactly one authorized effect and actual closure receipts. Custody/verifier/binding/correlation mutations must fail. Label every external substitution and make no live proof claim.
material_failure_classes: Denied-network lifecycle uses actual local Git publication and fresh verifier retrieval and rejects wrong/unpublished candidate identity.
Distinct producer/verifier flow exercises rejection-repair-fresh-candidate and accepted REVIEW/ACCEPT/closure without success-collapse shortcuts.
Missing, stale or miscorrelated durable role/invocation/candidate outcome evidence holds despite process success; duplicate/restart remains idempotent.
Judgment-required outcomes hold correctly and exactly one authorized effect/readback identity is retained.
Custody, verifier independence, binding and correlation negative controls fail while restored canonical behavior passes.
non_claims: No live transport/shared-profile/sovereignty proof is claimed.
No scenario-written lifecycle state or parallel outcome sidecar is allowed.

candidate_custody.policy: Future PRODUCER pins contract/input/baseline/profile and candidate branch+full SHA; publishes candidate to configured authorized remote and records exact branch/SHA on the Issue before RESULT=VERIFY. Fresh independent verifier retrieves that exact SHA in its own worktree; retain retrieval and verdict receipts.
candidate_custody.closure: Retain actor-owned branch/worktree through required closure; disposition LANDED, DISCARDED or PARKED with durable blocker. No direct main push by a BIU worker.
candidate_custody.current_artifact: Candidate specification only; no Issue, branch publication, implementation commit or worker invocation created by Phase 12.

landing: SWF-19: merge exact accepted candidate SHA; no pull request.
stop_condition: Hold this BIU on unmet dependency proof, unbound budget/custody, authority gap/gate, source revision mismatch, unavailable evidence, failing discriminating probe or conflicting ownership. Preserve unrelated completed proof.
escalation_condition: Return a defect in K3/S0/C1 to its owner; preserve unrelated completed proof.
Any live transport, shared-profile activation, sovereignty or retirement claim remains outside this offline capstone.
readiness: Remain TASKS until all predecessors are DONE and fresh native Agent Ready returns READY; no release authority.
